description: Grep variant coverage matrix over the shared mount fixture (mount-fixture-manifest.json), the cross-language contract for EndoMount.grep(pattern, options?). Each case is { name, pattern, options?, expect } where `pattern` is an ECMAScript RegExp source (no flags), `options` carries the optional `glob` (file-selection pattern, default '**/*') and `maxResults` (match cap, default 1000), and `expect` is the exact array of { file, line, text } records grep returns — ordered by the file's UTF-16 glob order, then by 1-based line number, with any trailing carriage return stripped from `text`. Cases scope `options.glob` to text files so the binary probe (docs/img.png) never perturbs a pinned expectation; CRLF normalization and the binary no-failure guarantee are covered by dedicated Node unit tests in mount-grep.test.js, not by this table. The Node runner is mount-grep.test.js; a Rust/XS-side runner consumes this same JSON to assert identical results.

cases.name: plain literal across a recursive glob
multi-match in one file with 1-based line numbers
caret anchors to the line start
dollar anchors to the line end
caret with a longer prefix selects a single file
character class matches only the selected digits
options.glob restricts the searched file set (non-recursive)
maxResults caps the record count mid-file
recursive markdown search spans depths in UTF-16 file order
a pattern with no match yields an empty result
